keyEvents.text: Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Osasuna 0, Athletic Club 0.
Second Half begins Osasuna 0, Athletic Club 0.
Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Oihan Sancet replaces Robert Navarro.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Iñigo Ruiz de Galarreta replaces Beñat Gerenabarrena.
Substitution, Osasuna. Asier Osambela replaces Jon Moncayola.
Substitution, Osasuna. Jonathan Dubasin replaces Raúl Moro.
Substitution, Osasuna. Iker Muñoz replaces Moi Gómez.
Substitution, Osasuna. Raúl García replaces Ante Budimir.
Substitution, Osasuna. Kike Barja replaces Rubén García.
Goal! Osasuna 0, Athletic Club 1. Nico Williams (Athletic Club) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a fast break.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Beñat Prados replaces Peio Canales.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Johaneko Louis-Jean replaces Nico Williams because of an injury.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Yeray Álvarez replaces Alex Berenguer.
Goal! Osasuna 1, Athletic Club 1. Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
